item.title: Trump Warns Iran: “We will strike where it hurts the most” amid protests
item.description: Political turmoil in Iran has intensified amid widespread protests against rising inflation and economic hardship. US President Donald Trump has issued a sharp warning to Tehran, saying Washington is closely monitoring the situation and will intervene if protesters are harmed.

item.title: JD(U) Expels 12 Leaders for Six Years Over Alleged Betrayal in Bihar Elections
item.description: JD(U) has expelled 12 senior leaders for six years over alleged betrayal during Bihar Assembly Elections 2025. The action, based on a probe report, signals the party’s zero-tolerance policy towards indiscipline and anti-party activities.

item.title: Iran in Turmoil: Tehran sees deadliest night; Over 200 protesters Killed
item.description: Iran is witnessing its deadliest unrest in years as violent protests swept through Tehran and several other cities overnight. At least 217 people have reportedly been killed in the capital alone, with clashes spreading to more than 100 cities nationwide.

item.title: Railways announce special trains for Magh Mela devotees; Check timings
item.description: Indian Railways has announced unreserved special trains from Punjab to Prayagraj to facilitate devotees travelling for Magh Mela 2026. Special trains will run from Amritsar and Firozpur Cantt on selected dates in January and February.

item.title: Speeding Audi mows down over 15 vendors in Jaipur killing at least one
item.description: This horrific accident occurred near Kharabas Circle in the Journalist Colony police station area of ​​Jaipur. The speeding Audi car crushed pedestrians and stalls along the roadside.

item.title: DN Exclusive | From Mud Houses to Marble Halls: Petwar Village Welcomes Its Pride, CJI Surya Kant
item.description: Dynamite News reports from Petwar village as CJI Justice Surya Kant returns to his ancestral home. Villagers prepare a grand traditional felicitation, celebrating his inspiring journey from a rural Haryana village to India’s highest judicial position.

item.title: Nissan Tekton debuts soon; Targets India’s mid-size SUV segment
item.description: Nissan is gearing up to launch its new mid-size SUV, the Tekton, on February 4. Aimed at rivals like Hyundai Creta and Kia Seltos, the SUV features a bold Patrol-inspired design, premium interiors and advanced technology.

item.title: NCP (SP) and NCP come together for Pune civic polls; Release joint manifesto
item.description: The two rival factions of the NCP are in an alliance for the PMC election. Despite their political differences at the state and national levels, the two factions have projected a united development agenda for Pune.

item.title: DN Exclusive | CJI Surya Kant Returns to Petwar Village for First Felicitation Since Assuming Office
item.description: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant visits his ancestral village Petwar in Hisar for the first time since assuming office. Villagers and dignitaries honor his journey from humble beginnings to the country’s highest judicial position.
